messages:
Ravi: Edgeflow just offered a 5-week preview of their EdgeCard v3 for us to run inference workloads. They require an internal-only NDA and a short feedback form after our test run. Who can pick this up? cc @Jo @Linh :wave:

Jo: I can take infra + harness wiring. Need the QC image and any boot args. Also confirm models: 8B/32B or do we do 70B too?

Linh: Ill handle experiment definitions and eval sets. Prefer to validate both 8B latency profiles and 32B long-context behavior (16k). We should include cold-start vs warm-start runs.

Legal-Bot: Reminder  NDA clause: no public benchmarks or press releases without partner sign-off. Also export controls: check if EdgeCard includes restricted crypto. Submit legal@redwood for review if doubtful.

Edgeflow-Rep: Hi team  happy to provide images, SSH accounts, and sample telemetry. We'll also supply a CSV power trace file and a small JSON schema for our agent. Note: we prefer the 8B and 32B targets; 70B is allowed but throughput will be limited.

Jo: Cool. I'll provision a test bed in our sandbox and point to their image. InfraOps, can you carve out 3 nodes for the week of 2024-04-08? Need GPU pins and a reserved IP range.

InfraOps: Done. Created reservation: sandbox-edgecard-04-08 with 3 nodes. Image uploaded to s3://edgeflow-preview/edgecard-v3.img (14.2G).

Ravi: Metrics we want: p50/p90 generation latency, tokens/sec, mem high-water, power-avg, power-90p. Also KV cache hit/miss and batch-size distribution. Set target draft by 2024-04-18 so partnerships can sync PR schedule.

Linh: For reproducibility, I'll add the exact flags and seeding. Example run:
```
./run_eval --model redwood/32b-16k --seq 16384 --batch 1 --warm 500 --samples 200
```
I'll also capture system info: kernel, cudnn, driver, and firmware.

Jo: Telemetry integration plan:
```
export EDGEFLOW_TELEMETRY=https://ingest.edgeflow/api
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood-edge-zzzz
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json $EDGEFLOW_TELEMETRY
```
We will gate submission behind a token that Legal approves for test-only use.

Edgeflow-Rep: We'll provide API tokens and example payloads. We can also run an initial smoke test together in their lab and stream logs.

Legal-Bot: Add a short approval step: any external slide/deck must be sent to Edgeflow for sign-off 72 hours before release. I'll add that to the repo as a checklist.

Ravi: Let's schedule a sync Wednesday 09:30 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry schema, bench plan, legal guardrails, sign-off timeline.

InfraOps: Sync confirmed. Invite sent to Edgeflow.

Linh: I'll upload the eval set and a draft runbook to the repo: https://git.redwood/integration/edgeflow-preview/runbook.md

Jo: Thanks — I'll start wiring the harness and post early logs in the repo. If Edgeflow can provide power CSVs, that would make our capacity analysis much simpler.

Edgeflow-Rep: We will. Expect power CSV and per-step timings next week. Looking forward to the run. :rocket:
